# Waiverfile

WaiverFile is an electronic waiver form system that allows customers to sign release waivers from any device, streamlining the waiver management process.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/waiverfile/.

## Actions

- **Get Site Details** (read-only): Fetch public details about the waiverfile site.
